description: A React functional component named ConnectionForm that provides a user interface for connecting to Atlassian services (JIRA or Confluence) with support for multiple authentication methods including OAuth 2.0, API Token, and Basic Auth. The component manages form states, validation, OAuth flow initiation, and displays relevant UI elements and help information.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form data based on the selected authentication method, checking for required fields and URL validity.

methods.name: isValidUrl
methods.description: Utility function to check if a string is a valid URL.

methods.name: handleCredentialSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, validates input, constructs credentials object, and calls the onSubmit prop.

methods.name: handleOAuthFlow
methods.description: Initiates the OAuth flow by requesting OAuth URL, opening a popup for user authentication, and listening for completion messages.

methods.name: handleInputChange
methods.description: Updates form data state when user inputs change, and clears errors for that field.
